title: icsprio v1.0.0: an open Python package for fetching, joining, and prioritizing ICS advisories

creators.name: Mike-Ewewie, David
creators.affiliation: Computer Science Department, University of Texas Permian Basin, Odessa, Texas, USA

description: icsprio fetches, joins, and prioritizes ICS vulnerability intelligence from CISA ICS Advisories (CSAF 2.0), the CISA KEV catalog, FIRST.org EPSS, CISA Vulnrichment, and MITRE ATT&CK for ICS into one deterministic, reproducible table with a documented, overridable priority score. See the repository README and docs/ for the full methodology, scoring formula, and known limitations.
